description: Zug accumulates observations by appending but has no frequency signal. When the same pattern appears across multiple sessions, it should carry more weight in synthesis. Add a reinforce mechanism (explicit call or auto-detection during synthesis) that promotes high-frequency patterns and marks them as load-bearing in PERSONA.md. Analogous to Storybloq's 'lesson reinforce'.
title: Observation reinforcement — frequency signal on repeating patterns
